info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Customer Term Deposit-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the creation of term deposit accounts for banking customers. By depositing a specified amount for a fixed term, customers can enhance their savings while earning interest. Financial institutions can use this API to streamline the onboarding process for term deposits, ensuring a seamless user experience. Typical consumers include banking applications and financial services platforms that manage customer accounts and investment options.

post.summary: Create a new term deposit for a specific customer.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new term deposit for the customer identified by CUST-100045. Ensure that the required parameters are provided in the request body to successfully create the term deposit.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create a new term deposit for the specified customer. It includes all the necessary information required to process the term deposit, such as the deposit amount, term length, interest rate, and other related details.
